total.instructions: The total amount charged or paid on this receipt or invoice, including tax. Not a subtotal.

date.instructions: The date of the receipt, invoice or payment. If only a due date is shown, use the due date. If a numeric date is ambiguous, read it as day/month/year.

date_text.instructions: The date of the receipt, invoice or payment, copied exactly as it is written.

supplier.instructions: The name of the business that issued the receipt or invoice.

currency.instructions: The currency symbol or code written next to the total, for example £, $, US$, €, GBP, USD or EUR.
